reasoning: Round 1's single finding is fixed: the rationale sentence is gone from the requirement and stays only in design.md Risks. Every class is ok: the core's own switch is set by a plain write, a failure is visible, the RED unit tests are named, and the live step checks that its fixture is still current.

simpler.evidence: design.md Decision 1 uses the core's own switch with a plain write. It rejects a defineProperty setter like the DMCA one because there is one reader that reads once (Context: a single disable_features.kinopoisk match in app.min.js?v=1994913). Bypassing ServiceKinopoisk is ruled out in Standard approach, since it lives inside the core's closure. Decision 2 copies disableDmca (plugins/kp-reactions-fix.js:1004-1018) and adds no shared helper (§VII). Decision 3 adds one step to the existing tmdb-access.sh. tests/live/kp-trailers/lib.js:59 openCard already opens a card and waits for .button--kp-torrent, but it also depends on kp-trailers state (__kpCard, focus checks for ui.py). Keeping the tmdb-access requirement in tmdb-access.sh costs only a few duplicated lines. No simpler design meets all three scenarios.

map.evidence: The spec delta has 3 scenarios, and tasks.md 'Scenario → test map' maps each one. 'Карточка из списка Кинопоиска с кнопками плагина' maps to the live step kinopoisk-card in tests/live/tmdb-access.sh (tasks 3.1, run at 5.3 after restart_lampa). 'Флаг записан до старта приложения' maps to the unit test 'kinopoisk list disabled before app start'. 'Список Кинопоиска не отключён — это видно' maps to 'kinopoisk list not disabled: noty and error', with cases launched: 1 and settings: null.

red.evidence: tasks.md 1.1 adds disable_features: {kinopoisk: false} to the default settings of load() (tests/js/kp-reactions-fix.test.js:158) and a new launched option. Before the change, both new tests fail: the flag stays false, and no decision-2 message is emitted. The existing 'dmca not disabled' test (:1662) filters messages by text, so the new kinopoisk messages in its frozen and null cases do not break it. The new tests must filter the same way: settings: null also triggers disableDmca's messages, and 'по одному сообщению решения 2' in 1.1 requires matching by text. 1.2 runs check_red on tests/test_plugin_js.py::test_plugin_js, which runs node --test over tests/js/*.test.js.

platform.evidence: Observed on the device on 2026-11-23 with cdp.py, recorded in proposal.md Why: the list response (85 records, containing {id:105276, cat:'tv', kpid:1355059}); no full events in 5 s for tv/105276, against start/build×3/complite for tv/124364; the button--kinopoisk button; disable_features.kinopoisk false. Cited from core code (app.min.js?v=1994913, matching yumata/lampa-source): the early return in init, the creation of lampa_settings at top level, and startApp setting app_time_launch before ServiceKinopoisk.init. The key claim is that Plugins.load waits for the plugin scripts before showApp. design.md Context gives it without a line number, but it is already on record with line numbers in openspec/changes/archive/2026-11-18-now-watching-new-releases/design.md:58 (app.min.js:67786, :45937-45960). Context could point there instead of restating it. Either way, step 5.3 proves the order on the device.

replaced.evidence: The change switches off a core restriction (the 'watch on Kinopoisk' redirect) and replaces no input that the project declares. What stops working is ServiceKinopoisk.allow removing listed titles from the DMCA list. design.md Risks names this, and its catcher is the existing requirement 'Без DMCA-блокировки клиента', checked by the dmca-unblocked step, which runs before kinopoisk-card in the same script. Context reports that the flag has a single reader, so no other path stops proving.

catcher.evidence: Unit tests run in the pre-commit manual stage (pre-push and agent-process / quality, on every PR head). The live kinopoisk-card step runs at 5.3 on the branch sha and again after merge (Migration Plan). Per its header (tests/live/tmdb-access.sh:7-8), it also runs before every sha change of kp-reactions-fix.js. A late plugin start is caught at runtime by Noty and console.error (Decision 2). If a future core reads the flag under another name, nothing scheduled catches it: the live step catches it on its next run, and until then the user sees the core's 'Смотреть на Кинопоиске' button, as before this change. That matches what was accepted for disable-dmca-block. Every catcher traces to a step that runs.

length.evidence: The requirement 'Без списка «Смотреть на Кинопоиске»' (specs/tmdb-access/spec.md:4-8) is now 56 words, all of them asserted. SHALL NOT apply the list, and the card shows the plugin's 'Торренты' and 'Трейлер' buttons: the live step kinopoisk-card. The flag is true before the app starts: 'kinopoisk list disabled before app start'. Noty plus console.error on failure or late start: 'kinopoisk list not disabled: noty and error'. The DMCA-dependency rationale now lives only in design.md Risks (line 59).

bespoke.evidence: design.md '## Standard approach' cites the core's own switch (yumata/lampa-source, src/components/full/start/buttons.js, button--kinopoisk branch) and records a dated gh search code that found no existing plugin, only Kinopoisk-rating plugins that do not touch the list. That is convincing, and the design follows the standard switch rather than bypassing it. The plan adds no new script or check: kinopoisk-card.js is one step in the existing tmdb-access.sh live check, built on the helpers in tests/live/tmdb-access/lib.js, like dmca-unblocked.js.
